derived.method: (4,238,762 Class A + 62,917,140 Class B beneficially owned) / (433,034,896 Class A + 185,611,689 Class B outstanding at April 7, 2025) = 67,155,902 / 618,646,585. The 9,200,000 non-voting Class H shares are left out of the denominator because all are held by Airbnb's own wholly-owned subsidiary and the 10-K computes net income per share only for Class A and Class B; including them gives 10.70%. Chesky's row contains no options or RSUs (footnote 1). Computed, not stated in the filing.

structure.note: Class A shares carry one vote and Class B shares twenty votes; Class H (held by Airbnb's own subsidiary) has none. Brian Chesky holds 30.5% of the voting power, Nathan Blecharczyk 29.7% and Joe Gebbia 19.0% (2025 proxy). All three co-founders' shares are subject to a Founder Voting Agreement under which they vote for each other's election to the board. No single holder has a majority.

Sources: FY2024 Form 10-K (accession 0001559720-25-000010; note that its tables list years oldest first, 2022, 2023, 2024) and 2025 proxy statement (DEF 14A, accession 0001193125-25-096938, ownership as of April 7, 2025). OWNERSHIP: the proxy gives Chesky 1.0% of Class A, 33.9% of Class B and 30.5% of voting power but no percentage of all shares, so pctEconomic is null and the 10.86% economic share is in leader.derived. Excluding Class H is a judgment call, explained in derived.method; including it gives 10.70%. 5% HOLDERS: largestHolders is null because the proxy gives no figure on an all-shares basis. Its only 5% holders are Sequoia Capital entities (511,074 Class A, marked *; 21,571,316 Class B, 11.6% of Class B; 10.4% of voting power, per a Schedule 13G filed November 5, 2024) and the Airbnb Host Endowment LLC (all 9,200,000 non-voting Class H shares, a wholly-owned subsidiary), plus the co-founders Blecharczyk (61,636,357 Class B, 33.2%) and Gebbia (39,331,884 Class B, 21.2%) in the directors' table. Sequoia's class percentages cannot be converted without deriving, and the proxy lists no Class A institutional holder above 5%. No dividends have been paid, and the cash-flow statement has no dividend line. Buybacks exclude $630 million of taxes paid on equity awards.

tourismTax.label: Tourism taxes collected and remitted on behalf of hosts
tourismTax.definition: "Total tourism taxes collected and remitted on behalf of hosts in 2024", as listed by Airbnb for selected states only (19 states and Washington, DC); rounded to the nearest million.

jobsSupported.label: Estimated jobs supported (Airbnb IMPLAN analysis)
jobsSupported.definition: Jobs supported by Airbnb guest spending in Canada, from Airbnb's internal analysis using the IMPLAN economic impact model ('over 105,000 jobs'). Estimate.

jobsSupportedOE.label: Jobs supported (Oxford Economics study)
jobsSupportedOE.definition: Jobs supported by the economic activity Airbnb generates, from the Oxford Economics study Airbnb commissioned for 10 Asia-Pacific countries ('Airbnb commissioned Oxford Economics ... to assess the impact of Airbnb’s ecosystem on communities throughout Asia Pacific').

impactGdp.label: Estimated total contribution to GDP from travel on Airbnb
impactGdp.definition: Airbnb's own estimate: "Estimated economic impact based on an internal analysis using the IMPLAN economic impact model which assesses direct, indirect and induced economic activity." State map column 'Total Contribution to GDP'. An estimate, not a reported transaction.

impactJobs.label: Estimated jobs supported (Airbnb IMPLAN analysis)
impactJobs.definition: Jobs supported by Airbnb guest and host activity, from Airbnb's internal IMPLAN-model analysis (U.S. state map column 'Total Jobs Supported', published rounded, e.g. '12.2K'; Canada from the Canadian 2024 release). Estimate.

impactTax.label: Estimated total tax generated
impactTax.definition: "Estimated taxes associated with economic activity generated by Airbnb stays" (state map column 'Total Tax Generated'), from the same internal IMPLAN analysis. Broader than, and not comparable to, tourismTax.

footprint.notes: usStates: 2024 tourism taxes collected and remitted on behalf of hosts for the 19 states plus Washington, DC that Airbnb lists in its newsroom post (it also lists British Columbia, Ontario and Quebec in CAD, which are provinces and not used). Airbnb's 2024 U.S. economic impact release (news.airbnb.com/economic-impact-2024-us) links a 50-state map (GDP contribution, jobs supported, tax generated; internal IMPLAN estimates), but its data is an Airbnb-authored Flourish chart hosted on flo.uri.sh with the rows inside a <script> block, so it fits none of the allowed host types and cannot pass the quote verifier; those 50 rows were held out of this file. Countries: jobs supported in 9 Asia-Pacific countries from Airbnb's Oxford Economics-commissioned 2024 study (company-commissioned; Thailand is 'Nearly 110,000', recorded as 110,000). Vietnam's page reports 2025, not 2024, and is omitted. Canada's 'over 105,000 jobs' (plus) is from Airbnb's internal IMPLAN analysis (company-published). Local-currency GDP figures per country were not recorded, to avoid mixing currencies. No 2024 host-earnings-by-state data was found in the time available. 10-K Item 2 names only the San Francisco headquarters. [Editor] Added the 50-state 2024 U.S. economic impact map (Airbnb-authored Flourish chart embedded at news.airbnb.com/economic-impact-2024-us).
